How to read this

These are event counts, not unique people or a matched conversion funnel. Repeat visits count again. Each action counts at most once per page load. Dates use UTC.

Booking clicks include jumps to the calendar and direct links to Cal.com. Calendar opens count requests to load the embedded calendar. Submitted bookings count successful new submissions reported by that embed; they are not verified appointments, payments, or completed calls.

Direct Cal.com bookings, reschedules, cancellations, blocked analytics, and visitors using Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control are not included in submitted bookings. Use Cal.com for the complete booking record. No historical traffic has been backfilled.

Only daily totals for Home, Services, Start Here, About, and Resources are stored. No names, contact details, answers, booking references, cookies, device identifiers, query strings, or referring URLs are stored in these counters. Older totals are removed after 90 days when another event arrives.
